Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    varIsAdmin,
    Navigate(Screen_Settings, ScreenTransition.Fade),
    Notify("Settings are for admins only", NotificationType.Error)
)

Coalesce(varSelectedWeekEmployeeName, "All") & " | Week of " &
Text(varApprovalWeekStart, "mmm d") & " - " &
Text(DateAdd(varApprovalWeekStart, 6, "Days"), "mmm d, yyyy")
"Apply status and comment edits from this screen"
"Approve every pending and rejected row in this week"

Filter(
    colApprovalWeekHours,
    (
        IsBlank(varSelectedWeekEmployee) ||
        Employee = varSelectedWeekEmployee
    ) &&
    (
        varApprovalStatusFilter = "All" ||
        (
            varApprovalStatusFilter = "Pending" &&
            ApprovalStatus_1 = "Pending"
        ) ||
        (
            varApprovalStatusFilter = "Reviewed" &&
            (
                ApprovalStatus_1 = "Approved" ||
                ApprovalStatus_1 = "Rejected"
            )
        )
    )
)

If(ThisItem.ApprovalStatus_1 = "Approved", RGBA(108, 212, 136, 1), ThisItem.ApprovalStatus_1 = "Rejected", RGBA(252, 124, 124, 1), ThisItem.ApprovalStatus_1 = "Pending", RGBA(252, 250, 124, 1), RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1))
